description: A scripted audience for any talk that shows pages, to watch one of your own: someone asks to go back a page in the middle of it, and for the first page again at the end. Run it with --talk and --screen, or with --show-screen --hear to watch and listen. Lines are timed by how long Stand has spoken.

during.label: asks for the page before
during.say: Sorry, can you go back to the previous page for a second?

after.label: asks for the first page
after.say: Could you put the very first page back up?

goodbye.label: goodbye
goodbye.say: Thanks, that's all the questions we have.
